{{Quote|I don't have time for this, Natho. You're jamming my channel. Again. Don't you have work to do?|Kejik|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kejik''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was working with of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was annoyed by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Natho]], who claimed he could help Kejik with an assault on the [[Okara Droid Factory]]. Kejik refused to believe him until a fellow Republic citizen convinced him otherwise. Kejik then coordinated both Natho and the spacer in a mission to infect factory droids with a disruptive virus.

==Behind the scenes==
According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} conversation files, Kejik was originally named Forren.
